import asyncio

issues = []
start = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/start.txt"})
path = start['data']['text'].strip()
chain = []
guard = 0
while path and path != "END":
    guard += 1
    if guard > 3000:
        issues.append("guard hit")
        break
    r = await yuki_workspace_read({"path": "/workspace/" + path})
    if not r.get('ok'):
        issues.append("read fail: " + path)
        break
    text = r['data']['text']
    kv = {}
    for line in text.splitlines():
        s = line.strip()
        if '=' in s:
            k, v = s.split('=', 1)
            kv[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    if 'value' not in kv:
        issues.append("no value: " + path)
        break
    value = int(kv['value'])
    chain.append([path, value])
    if value % 2 == 0:
        path = kv.get('left', 'END').strip()
    else:
        path = kv.get('right', 'END').strip()

total = sum(v for _, v in chain)
lines = [p + "\t" + str(v) for p, v in chain]
lines.append("TOTAL\t" + str(total))
content = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

w = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "/workspace/chain.tsv", "text": content})

audit = []
for i, (p, v) in enumerate(chain):
    name = "audit/" + str(i).zfill(2) + ".txt"
    ar = await yuki_workspace_write({"path": "/workspace/" + name, "text": str(v) + "\n"})
    audit.append([name, ar.get('ok'), ar.get('data', {}).get('version', '')[:12]])
